title: Create release snapshot templates and rapid review sprint for customer-facing changelogs
creator: Sofia Patel
description:
Problem: We lack a compact, review-friendly set of templates and a predictable sprint process for drafting customer-facing changelogs across product tiers (developer, enterprise admin, end-user). This causes last-minute legal/design reviews, inconsistent messaging, and translation delays for launches.

Goal: Deliver a small family of release snapshot templates (1-line summary, admin summary, technical bullet list, and customer digest) plus a 5-day rapid review sprint runbook and signoff checklist that Product, Design, Legal, Security, and Eng can use to iterate and approve changelogs reliably. Templates should be copy-pasteable into the console change UI and our public changelog page, and structured to support localization and A/B messaging variants.

Scope: Template creation, review workflow definition, ownership matrix, sample filled templates for the upcoming console-2026.03 release, and a small pilot with CS/PE to validate downstream assets (docs, release email, in-console banners). Localization handoff shape (strings + context) included. Excludes creating translation bundles (handled in follow-up ticket).
acceptance_criteria: A set of four approved templates exist: Snapshot (1-liner), Admin Summary, Developer Tech Bullets, Customer Digest
A documented 5-day rapid review sprint runbook is published with explicit reviewer roles (PM, Design, Legal, Security, Eng) and SLAs
Signed-off sample changelog for console-2026.03 is uploaded and linked to the release playbook
Template fields support localization (string keys + context) and a localization handoff checklist is attached
Stakeholders (CS, Support, DevRel) confirm the sample fits downstream needs in a short pilot call
comments: 2026-02-18 Sofia Patel: Kickoff — scoped templates: 'Snapshot (1-liner)', 'Admin Summary', 'Developer Tech Bullets', 'Customer Digest'. Proposed 3-step approval: PM -> Design -> Legal/Security -> Eng as optional fast path for docs-only items. Noted need to support embargoed releases and per-tier messaging.

Marked two phrases as potentially implying guarantees — suggested neutral language. Assigned follow-up: PM to provide exact rollout timing and affected model list for risk review.

Runbook includes an SLA matrix: PM initial draft (day 0), Design 24h, Legal/Security 48h, Eng advisory 48h, final PM signoff within 24h after last reviewer. Draft posted to Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/Launch/PM-67234+Release+Snapshot+Runbook

2026-03-09 Ava Martinez (Legal): Legal signoff pending final rollout dates. Requested inclusion of audit log reference for any changes affecting Private customers. Added note to template: 'For Private customers: see audit log reference <link>'.
